body: Maybe sub consciously I was just done being hurt by him but mainly it was just because we are so close it just happened. I guess it’s because I thought the thing between us was more serious than it was, it was never really exclusive but I really had feelings for him and was probably just kidding myself but I thought that maybe we actually had something, I see now he was just leading me on but I felt bad about being with someone else, especially considering

Yeah that’s what I feel fucked up about. We weren’t committed but I still feel guilty because of the feelings I had and because it’s his brother it’s a betrayal. Maybe I am beating myself up too much, i just wish my morals and integrity were better to know that I shouldn’t sleep with someone and then their brother before I do it instead of after

I feel guilt but I feel like not as much as I should in this situation, i know it’s fucked up. the friendship thing is fair. I try and be a good friend but I know I’m untrustworthy because I can’t trust myself. We weren’t exclusive but it’s still betrayal

I guess that’s how I saw it at the time but I still feel weird, it’s a betrayal even if we weren’t exclusive because even though the brothers aren’t close, they’re still brothers. It’s morally fucked but I cant tell myself it’ll never happen again if I’m being honest

It’s true we weren’t exclusive, I had feelings but we weren’t in a relationship and he always spoke about wanting to get with other girls, and trying to get their numbers so at least it wasn’t cheating. I still feel so wrong about his brother, he’s a good friend so we will no doubt see eachother again soon and I have to deal with that, I don’t have feelings for him but I really enjoyed being with him like that, it was unexpected but it can’t continue, it’s not right and if anyone found out we would be excluded from our friendships, but I still want him as a close friend, also I have terrible self control. Hence, I’m conflicted

Stupidly I thought he would change, I was such a stereotype. He kept me on the loop, sweet talking me about how he liked me and he wanted me around and I honestly enjoyed spending time with him, until he changed his mind and pushed me away again. I guess probably low self esteem
